The First Khutbah

Praise be to Allah, who has made the remembrance (of Him) a sanctuary for His worshippers, a garden for the pious, and I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without any partners. He says in His clear Book, So remember Me; I will remember you. And I bear witness that our master and prophet, Muhammad, is the servant of Allah and His trustworthy messenger. O Allah, bestow peace, blessings, and grace upon him, his family, his companions, and those who follow him.

To Continue: As for what follows, I advise you, O servants of Allah and myself, to adhere to the Taqwa of Allah. Through it, the servant draws near to his Lord, finds happiness in this world and the Hereafter, as Allah, in His exalted status, says, يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ‌اعْبُدُوا ‌رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ

O Mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous. [Qur'an: 2:152]

O believers, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessing of Allah be upon him, said:

إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلَائِكَةً يَطُوفُونَ فِي الطُّرُقِ يَلْتَمِسُونَ أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ، فَإِذَا وَجَدُوا قَوْمًا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ تَنَادَوْا: هَلُمُّوا إِلَى حَاجَتِكُمْ، فَيَحُفُّونَهُمْ بِأَجْنِحَتِهِمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، فَيَسْأَلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ، وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ مِنْهُمْ: مَا يَقُولُ عِبَادِي؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: يُسَبِّحُونَكَ وَيُكَبِّرُونَكَ وَيَحْمَدُونَكَ وَيُمَجِّدُونَكَ. فَيَقُولُ: هَلْ رَأَوْنِي؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَا وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَوْكَ. فَيَقُولُ: وَكَيْفَ لَوْ رَأَوْنِي؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَوْ رَأَوْكَ كَانُوا أَشَدَّ لَكَ عِبَادَةً، وَأَشَدَّ لَكَ تَمْجِيدًا وَتَحْمِيدًا، وَأَكْثَرَ لَكَ تَسْبِيحًا. فَيَقُولُ: فَمَا يَسْأَلُونِي؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: يَسْأَلُونَكَ الْجَنَّةَ. فَيَقُولُ: وَهَلْ رَأَوْهَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَا وَاللَّهِ يَا رَبِّ مَا رَأَوْهَا. فَيَقُولُ: فَكَيْفَ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ رَأَوْهَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ رَأَوْهَا كَانُوا أَشَدَّ عَلَيْهَا حِرْصًا، وَأَشَدَّ لَهَا طَلَبًا، وَأَعْظَمَ فِيهَا رَغْبَةً. قَالَ: فَمِمَّ يَتَعَوَّذُونَ؟ قَالُوا: يَتَعَوَّذُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ. فَيَقُولُ: وَهَلْ رَأَوْهَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَا وَاللَّهِ يَا رَبِّ مَا رَأَوْهَا. فَيَقُولُ: فَكَيْفَ لَوْ رَأَوْهَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَوْ رَأَوْهَا كَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهَا فِرَارًا، وَأَشَدَّ لَهَا مَخَافَةً. فَيَقُولُ: فَإِنِّي أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَهُمْ. فَيَقُولُ مَلَكٌ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ: فِيهِمْ فُلَانٌ لَيْسَ مِنْهُمْ، إِنَّمَا جَاءَ لِحَاجَةٍ. قَالَ: هُمُ الْجُلَسَاءُ ‌لَا ‌يَشْقَى ‌بِهِمْ ‌جَلِيسُهُمْ

Indeed, Allah has angels who roam the roads/paths seeking those who making remembrance of Allah. When they find a group remembering Allah, they call one another, 'Come to what you are searching for.' They encircle and enfold them with their wings, reaching up to the lowest heaven. Their Lord asks them, although He knows better, 'What are My servants saying?' They reply, 'They glorify You, exalt You, praise You, and magnify You.' He asks, 'Have they seen Me?' They say, 'No, by Allah, they have not seen You.' He asks, 'And how would it be if they saw Me?' They say, 'If they saw You, they would be more devoted in worship, more ardent in glorification and praise, and more abundant in seeking Your forgiveness.' He asks, 'What are they asking Me?' They say, 'They are asking for Paradise.' He asks, 'Have they seen it?' They say, 'No, by Allah, O Lord, they have not seen it.' He asks, 'And how would it be if they saw it?' They say, 'If they saw it, they would be more eager for it, more desirous of it, and greater in their longing for it.' He then says, 'I bear witness that I have forgiven them.' An angel says, 'Among them is so-and-so, who is not one of them; he came only for some personal need.' Allah says, 'They are a gathering [of such rank], and no one in their gathering shall be miserable.' [Bukhari and Muslim]

Verily, the remembrance of Allah, O servants of Allah, is the fortress of souls, the strength of hearts, the nourishment of spirits, and the means of forgiveness. Allah, the Exalted, says, وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا ‌وَالذَّاكِرَاتِأَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

And the men who remember Allah much and the women who do so - for them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward. [Qur'an: 33:35]

Their scales become heavy with it, and they precede others to Paradise, as the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: سَبَقَ الْمُفَرِّدُونَ

The solitary ones have taken the lead.

They asked, Who are the solitary ones, O Messenger of Allah? He (peace and blessing of Allah be upon him) said:

الذَّاكِرُونَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتُ

Those who remember Allah frequently, both men and women. [Sahih Muslim]

O Allah, assist us in remembering You, expressing gratitude to You, performing excellent worship, and grant us success in obeying You, the obedience of Your Messenger Muhammad, and the obedience of those whom You have commanded us to obey, as per Your saying: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you.

I say these words, and I seek forgiveness from Allah for myself and for you, so seek His forgiveness, for He is the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

The Second Khutbah

All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all worlds, who has made remembrance a path for the seekers and their way to succeed in the gardens of delight. Peace and blessings be upon our master and prophet, Muhammad, the Seal of the Messengers, and upon his family, his companions, and all those who follow them. I advise you slaves of Allah and myself with the Taqwa of Allah, so have Taqwa of Him.

O you who remember Allah, indeed, the remembrance of Allah, the Almighty, is life for the souls and tranquility for the hearts. Allah, glorified is He, says,

أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ

Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah, hearts are assured. [Qur'an: 13:28]

The one who remembers Allah is guarded by the Most Merciful and placed under the protection against Satan. The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ؛ يُقَالُ لَهُ: كُفِيتَ وَوُقِيتَ، وَتَنَحَّى عَنْهُ الشَّيْطَانُ

Whoever leaves his house and says: 'In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no power or strength except with Allah,' it will be said to him: 'You have been sufficed, protected,' and the devil will retreat from him. [Tirmidhi]

And:

مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَقُولُ فِي صَبَاحِ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَمَسَاءِ كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ، ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ؛ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْءٌ

No servant says in the morning or in the evening three times: 'In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can harm on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing,' nothing will harm him. [Tirmidhi]

When a believer travels or enters a dwelling of a town or city, if he says: ثُمَّ قَالَ: ‌أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ؛ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْءٌ، حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ ذَلِكَ

I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created, [Muslim]

For such a believer, nothing will harm him until he departs from that place. Therefore, let us strive, O servants of Allah, to increase in the remembrance of Allah and to adhere to the supplications, advising our children to do the same. Let them be constant in remembrance during the morning and evening, during their travels and at home, in their meals and drinks, and in all their affairs and conditions. This is in accordance with Allah's command:

وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

And remember Allah often that you may succeed.

[Qur'an: 62:10]

O Allah, make us among those who remember You in all states – standing, sitting, and lying down – so that mercy may envelop them, tranquility may descend upon them, angels may surround them, and remember them before You. O Allah, grant stability, prosperity, and success to the United Arab Emirates. Guide our leaders, including Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed, his deputies, and the rulers of the Emirates, and the Crown Prince, to what You love and are pleased with. O Allah, have mercy on Sheikh Zayed, Sheikh Rashid, the founding leaders, Sheikh Maktoum, Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed, and admit them into Your vast Paradise through Your grace. Extend Your mercy and forgiveness to the martyrs of the nation, and grant ease and recovery to the sick and afflicted,

O Lord of all worlds. O Allah, forgive our parents, and have mercy on the Muslim men and women – the living and the deceased. O Allah, bless us.

O Allah, bless us. O Allah, bless us.

O Servants of Allah, remember Allah, the Majestic, and He will remember you. Express gratitude to Him, and He will increase you. Establish the prayer.

الخطبة الأولى

الحمد لله ذي الجود والكرم، أسبغ علينا وافر النعم، وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، وأشهد أن سيدنا ونبينا محمدا عبد الله ورسوله، فاللهم صل وسلم وبارك عليه وعلى آله وصحبه والتابعين.

أما بعد: فأوصيكم عباد الله بتقوى الله، اجتهدوا في تحصيلها، واستثمروا النعم في تثبيتها، واستضيئوا بنبراسها، ليديم الله عليكم نعمه ويزيدها، قال تعالى: (ومن يتق الله يجعل له مخرجا* ويرزقه من حيث لا يحتسب). 

أيها المؤمنون: قال الله سبحانه: (وإن تعدوا نعمة الله لا تحصوها إن الله لغفور رحيم)، وقال جل ثناؤه: (وأسبغ عليكم نعمه ظاهرة وباطنة). فنعم الله علينا متواترة، وأفضاله متكاثرة، لا يستطيع العاد لها إحصاء، ولا يملك لها استقصاء، ومن أعظمها: الصحة والاستقرار، قال عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه: النعيم هو ‌الأمن ‌والصحة، فهما تاج النعم كلها، قال الشاعر:

ولصحة الإنسان واستقراره ***

تاج لكل نعيمنا فاشكرهما

من دون أمن لا تحقق راحة ***

وبدون صحة جسمنا لن ننعما

أجل، إنه الأمان، الذي دعا به نبي الله إبراهيم عليه السلام ربه فقال: (رب اجعل هذا ‌البلد ‌آمنا)، وإنها الصحة والعافية، التي قال عنها النبي :صلى الله عليه وسلم: «فإن الناس لم يعطوا بعد اليقين شيئا ‌خيرا ‌من ‌العافية». فالصحة تاج من العافية على رؤوس الأصحاء، يمن بها عليهم ربهم، ويكرمهم بها خالقهم، كيف لا؟ وقد كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو ربه كل يوم قائلا: «اللهم ‌عافني ‌في ‌بدني».  فلا راحة بال، ولا هناءة عيش؛ إلا بالصحة، ولا صحة تامة إلا بالاستقرار، فهما سبب لبهجة الحياة، وبهما يتكامل نعيم الدنيا، قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «من أصبح منكم آمنا في سربه، معافى في جسده، عنده قوت يومه؛ فكأنما حيزت له الدنيا». ففي ظل نعمتي الصحة والأمان؛ يستطيع الإنسان أن يعبد الله تعالى، ويتقدم في علومه، ويرعى أسرته وأهله، وينمي مجتمعه، ويخدم وطنه، وبهذا يجمع خيري الدنيا والآخرة. فاللهم أدم علينا الصحة والعافية، والاطمئنان والاستقرار، ووفقنا جميعا لطاعتك، وطاعة رسولك محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وطاعة من أمرتنا بطاعته؛ عملا بقولك: (يا أيها الذين آمنوا أطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول وأولي الأمر منكم).

أقول قولي هذا وأستغفر الله لي ولكم، فاستغفروه إنه هو الغفور الرحيم.

الخطبة الثانية

الحمد لله ذي الفضل والإنعام، أكرمنا بالصحة والأمان،والصلاة والسلام على سيدنا ونبينا محمد خير الأنام، وعلى آله وصحبه ومن تبعهم بإحسان.

أيها الشاكرون لنعم الله تعالى: إن دوام نعم الله تعالى وزيادتها؛ مرهون بشكر الله عليها، قال سبحانه: (وإذ تأذن ربكم لئن شكرتم ‌لأزيدنكم) وإن نعمة الاستقرار من أعظم النعم أثرا، وأشملها خيرا، لذلك ذكرنا الله تعالى بها، وأمرنا بشكرها، فقال عز وجل: (‌فليعبدوا ‌رب هذا البيت* الذي أطعمهم من جوع وآمنهم من خوف).

وإن مما يعزز الأمان والاستقرار؛ الإعراض عن الشائعات، والابتعاد عن نشر الأقوال والأخبار المكذوبات، فإنه مما يكرهه الله تعالى، قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إن الله ‌كره ‌لكم ‌ثلاثا: -وذكر أولها- قيل وقال». وحذر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من عواقب نشر الشائعات فقال: «كفى بالمرء كذبا أن يحدث ‌بكل ‌ما ‌سمع». ورأى صلى الله عليه وسلم رجلا يعذب، فسأل عن ذنبه، فقيل: «إنه رجل كذاب، يكذب الكذبة فتحمل عنه في الآفاق».

فلنتق الله يا عباد الله فيما ننشره وفيما نكتبه، ولينظر كل إنسان إلى نعم الله عليه، ويعمل بما يرضيه سبحانه فيها، ويحافظ عليها، وينبه أهله وذريته إلى ذلك، ولنتذكر دوما أننا مسؤولون عن سائر النعم، قال عز وجل: (ثم لتسألن يومئذ ‌عن ‌النعيم).

فاللهم اجعلنا لك شاكرين، ولنعمك حافظين، وصل اللهم وسلم وبارك على سيدنا ونبينا محمد وعلى آله وصحبه أجمعين، وارض اللهم عن الخلفاء الراشدين: أبي بكر وعمر وعثمان وعلي، وعن سائر الصحابة الأكرمين، والتابعين لهم بإحسان إلى يوم الدين.

اللهم إنا نعوذ بك من زوال نعمتك، وتحول عافيتك، وفجاءة نقمتك، وجميع سخطك.

اللهم متعنا بأسماعنا وأبصارنا، وقوتنا دوما ما أحييتنا، وأدم على دولة الإمارات الاستقرار، والرقي والازدهار.

اللهم وفق رئيس الدولة الشيخ محمد بن زايد، ونوابه وإخوانه حكام الإمارات وولي عهده الأمين؛ لما تحبه وترضاه.

اللهم ارحم الشيخ زايد، والشيخ راشد، والقادة المؤسسين، وارحم اللهم الشيخ مكتوم، والشيخ خليفة بن زايد، وأدخلهم بفضلك فسيح جناتك.

 واشمل شهداء الوطن برحمتك وغفرانك. اللهم اغفر لآبائنا وأمهاتنا.

اللهم ارحم المسلمين والمسلمات: الأحياء منهم والأموات.

اللهم اسقنا الغيث، اللهم أغثنا، اللهم أغثنا، اللهم أغثنا.

عباد الله: اذكروا الله العظيم يذكركم، واشكروه على نعمه يزدكم. وأقم الصلاة.

The First Khutbah

Praise be to Allah, the Generous and Benevolent, who has bestowed upon us abundant blessings. I bear witness that there is nothing worthy of worship but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that our master and Prophet is Sayyiduna Muhammad, the servant and messenger of Allah. O Allah, bestow your blessings, peace, and grace upon him, his family, his companions, and those who follow him.

To Continue: As for what follows, I advise you, the servants of Allah, to observe taqwa diligently. Strive to attain it, invest your blessings in maintaining it, and illuminate your path with its light. May Allah preserve His blessings upon you and increase them, as He says:

وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا* وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ

And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out and provide for him from where he does not expect.

(Quran, 65:2-3)

O Believers: Allah, the Most-High, says,

وَإِنْ تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ

And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. (Quran, 16:18).

He also says, وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً

And He has bestowed upon you His favors, both apparent and hidden. (Quran, 31:20).

 

The blessings of Allah upon us are continuous, and His bounties are abundant, beyond the capacity of mere enumeration or investigation. Among the greatest of blessings are health and stability for Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, may Allah be pleased with him, said, Blessings include security and health. In fact, they are the crown of all blessings. As a poet said:

The health of a person and his security are the crown for all our blessings, so have gratitude.

Security brings peace of mind, and health brings vitality to our bodies, this is the right attitude.

Indeed, safety is the security that the Prophet Ibrahim (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) invoked when he said,

رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَذَا ‌الْبَلَدَ ‌آمِنًا

My Lord, make this city secure. (Quran, 14:35).

Concerning health and well-being, the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) mentioned:

فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ لَمْ يُعْطَوْا بَعْدَ الْيَقِينِ شَيْئًا ‌خَيْرًا ‌مِنَ ‌الْعَافِيَةِ

People are not given anything after certainty better than health. [Tirmidhi]

This is because there is no comfort, happiness, or well-being in life without health, and no complete health without stability. They are the means to the joy of life, and with them, the blessings of this world are perfected. The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to supplicate every day, اللَّهُمَّ ‌عَافِنِي ‌فِي ‌بَدَنِي

O Allah, grant me health in my body. [Adab al-Mufrad]

There is no rest or happiness in life without health. So, in the shadow of the blessings of health and security, a person can worship Allah, advance in knowledge, take care of his family, contribute to his community, serve his country, and thus gather the goodness of both this world and the Hereafter.Hence, the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said:مَنْ أَصْبَحَ مِنْكُمْ آمِنًا فِي سِرْبِهِ، مُعَافًى فِي جَسَدِهِ، عِنْدَهُ قُوتُ يَوْمِهِ؛ فَكَأَنَّمَا حِيزَتْ لَهُ الدُّنْيَا

“Whoever among you wakes up safe in his flock, healthy in his body, has the sustenance for his day; it is as if the world had come into his possession.” [Adab al-Mufrad]

In light of the blessings of health and safety a person can worship Allah, advance in their knowledge, take care of their family and family, develop their society, and serve their country, and in this way they can bring together the good of this world and the hereafter. O Allah, grant us good health, well-being, reassurance and stability, and grant us success in obeying You, the obedience of Your Messenger Muhammad, and the obedience of those whom You have commanded us to obey, as per Your saying: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you. I say these words, and I seek forgiveness from Allah for myself and for you, so seek His forgiveness, for He is the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

The Second Khutbah

All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all worlds, who has made remembrance a path for the seekers and their way to succeed in the gardens of delight. Peace and blessings be upon our master and Prophet, Sayyiduna Muhammad, the Seal of the Messengers, and upon his family, his companions, and all those who follow them with excellence. I advise you slaves of Allah and myself with the Taqwa of Allah, so have Taqwa of Him.

 

O grateful ones for the blessings of Allah, the continuity and increase of His blessings are tied to gratitude. For Allah, the Most-High, says, وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ ‌لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ

And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed: 'If you give thanks [by accepting faith], I will give you more; but if you are thankless, My punishment is severe indeed.'

(Quran, 14:7).

The blessing of stability is indeed among the greatest of blessings, encompassing goodness. Therefore, Allah, the Most-High, mentions it and commands us to be grateful for it, saying,

‌فَلْيَعْبُدُوا ‌رَبَّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ* الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ

So let them worship the Lord of this House, Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger, and has made them safe, [saving them] from fear. (Quran, 106:3-4).

Among the factors that enhance safety and stability is turning away from rumors and avoiding spreading false statements and news. Allah dislikes this, as the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said,

إِنَّ اللَّهَ ‌كَرِهَ ‌لَكُمْ ‌ثَلَاثًا: -وَذَكَرَ أَوَّلَهَا- قِيلَ وَقَالَ

Allah hates three things for you. He mentioned the first of these things being false talk and gossip [Bukhari], warning against the consequences of spreading rumors. He (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said,

كَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ كَذِبًا أَنْ يُحَدِّثَ ‌بِكُلِّ ‌مَا ‌سَمِعَ

It is sufficient falsehood for a person to speak of everything that he hears. [Muslim]

 

Similarly, the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) saw a person being tortured in a dream vision, in which he asked about the sin done to deserve this, to which it was said:

إِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ كَذَّابٌ، يَكْذِبُ الْكَذْبَةَ فَتُحْمَلُ عَنْهُ فِي الْآفَاقِ

He was a liar and he used to tell lies, and the people would report those lies on his authority till they spread all over the world. [Bukhari]

So, let us be conscious and have Taqwa of Allah, O servants of Allah, in what we circulate, write and say. Let every individual reflect on the blessings bestowed upon them by Allah, act in a manner pleasing to Him, preserve those blessings, and remind their family and descendants to do the same. Let us remember constantly that we are accountable for all the blessings, as Allah says, ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‌عَنِ ‌النَّعِيمِ

Then you will surely be asked that Day about the enjoyment [of favors]. (Quran, 102:8).

O Allah, make us among those who are grateful, protective of Your blessings. May Allah bless and grant success to the leaders of the UAE, especially Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed and his deputies, and the rulers of the Emirates. O Allah, have mercy on Sheikh Zayed, Sheikh Rashid, the founding leaders, and Sheikh Maktoum. Enter them into Your spacious gardens by Your favor. O Allah, have mercy on our parents, forgive the Muslims, the living and the deceased. O Allah, send down your mercy upon us.

O believers, remember Allah the Almighty, and He will remember you.

Thank Him for His blessings, and He will increase them. Establish the prayer.

الخطبة الأولى

الحمد لله الذي خلق النفوس وسواها، وقال في كتابه: (قد أفلح من زكاها) وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، وأشهد أن سيدنا ونبينا محمدا عبد الله ورسوله، فاللهم صل وسلم وبارك عليه وعلى آله وصحبه والتابعين.

أما بعد: فاتقوا الله عباد الله حق التقوى، وراقبوه في السر والنجوى، واعلموا أن العمر أيام، وأن الدنيا معبر، وفي تعاقب شهورها عبر، وفي انقضاء سنواتها فكر، ولنا بمن قبلنا أسوة، وفينا لمن بعدنا عبرة؛ (واتقوا يوما ‌ترجعون ‌فيه إلى الله ثم توفى كل نفس ما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون).

أيها المؤمنون: إن المرء لا يزال بخير ما كان له واعظ من نفسه، وكانت المحاسبة من همته، فالنفس أمارة بالسوء (إلا ما رحم ربي) وإنما ترقى درجتها بالمحاسبة، قال الله تعالى: (يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله ولتنظر نفس ما قدمت لغدواتقوا الله إن الله خبير بما تعملون) والفطن من راقب نفسه وحاسبها على ما فات، ونظر فيما ادخره لما هو آت، قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «ما منكم من أحد إلا سيكلمه الله، ليس بينه وبينه ترجمان، فينظر أيمن منه ‌فلا ‌يرى إلا ما قدم من عمله، ‌وينظر ‌أيسر ‌منه فلا يرى إلا ما قدم من عمله» فمن أراد الآخرة وسعى لها سعيها؛ فليكن في حساب مستمر لنفسه، مستديما طلب ما فيه رقيها، واستدامة سعادتها؛ ولتكن ثقته بالله ثابتة لا تتزعزع، وطموحه نحو المعالي لا يتوانى، بإرادة وتفاؤل، وأمل وسكينة، وطمأنينة وبر، قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «‌البر ‌ما ‌سكنت إليه النفس، واطمأن إليه القلب، والإثم ما لم تسكن إليه النفس، ولم يطمئن إليه القلب». فالسعيد من حاسب نفسه وراقبها، فيا فوزه وبشراه، كتب الله أجره، وثبته وأثابه.

عباد الله: تمضي السنوات من حياتنا وتطوى، وقد سجلت فيها أعمالنا، ودونت فيها أقوالنا وأفعالنا، (عند ربي ‌في ‌كتاب) وصفه ربنا سبحانه بأنه: (لا ‌يغادر صغيرة ولا كبيرة إلا أحصاها) فما أحرانا أن نجتهد في أداء ما افترضه الله علينا، عملا بقوله تعالى: (وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة وما تقدموا لأنفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله) ونحسن إلى الناس أجمعين، بحسن معاملتهم، وأداء حقوقهم، وعدم ظلمهم، قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «من كانت له مظلمة لأخيه من عرضه أو شيء؛ فليتحلله منه».

فاللهم أعنا على مراقبة أنفسنا، وأداء حقوق الناس علينا، ووفقنا جميعا لطاعتك، وطاعة محمد نبيك ورسولك صلى الله عليه وسلم، وطاعة من أمرتنا بطاعته في قولك: (يا أيها الذين آمنوا أطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول وأولي الأمر منكم).

أقول قولي هذا وأستغفر الله لي ولكم، فاستغفروه إنه هو الغفور الرحيم.

الخطبة الثانية

الحمد لله رب العالمين،والصلاة والسلام على سيدنا ونبينا محمد خاتم المرسلين، وعلى آله وصحبه ومن تبعهم بإحسان إلى يوم الدين.

أيها المصلون:قال الله تعالى:(يوم تجد كل نفس ما عملت من خير محضرا وما عملت من سوء تود ‌لو ‌أن ‌بينها وبينه أمدا بعيدا ويحذركم الله نفسه والله رءوف بالعباد) أي: رحيم بخلقه، يحب منهم أن يقبلوا عليه فيحسن إليهم، ويحذرهم نفسه رأفة بهم؛ ليستقيموا ‌على ‌صراطه ‌المستقيم، ‌ودينه ‌القويم، ويتبعوا رسوله الكريم صلى الله عليه وسلم. فليحاسب المؤمن نفسه؛ فينظر إلى علاقته بربه، فيتقيه ويطيعه، ويرجوه ويخافه (وأما من خاف مقام ربه ‌ونهى ‌النفس عن الهوى* فإن الجنة هي المأوى). وليحاسب نفسه في صلته بوالديه؛ فيبرهما ويحسن إليهما، (فلا تقل لهما أف ‌ولا ‌تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما) والزوجان يحاسبان أنفسهما، في علاقتهما بأبنائهما، فيحسنان تربيتهما، والطالب يحاسب نفسه في مدرسته، ليزيد في تحصيله، وكذلك المعلم مع طلابه، يحاسب نفسه، هل أخلص في تعليمهم، وتربيتهم وتوجيههم؟ ومن يعيش على تراب هذا الوطن، وينعم بخيراته، من مواطن أو مقيم، يسأل نفسه: ماذا قدم له من جهود تسهم في دوام استقراره، واستمرار رقيه وازدهاره؟ وكل في مجال عمله؛ يحاسب نفسه، ليستزيد من الخير، مراقبا خالقه، فهو المطلع على سره وجهره، (وما ‌يعزب ‌عن ‌ربك من مثقال ذرة في الأرض ولا في السماء ولا أصغر من ذلك ولا أكبر إلا في كتاب مبين).

هذا، وصل اللهم وسلم وبارك على سيدنا ونبينا محمد وعلى آله وصحبه أجمعين، وارض اللهم عن الخلفاء الراشدين: أبي بكر وعمر وعثمان وعلي، وعن سائر الصحابة الأكرمين، والتابعين لهم بإحسان إلى يوم الدين.

اللهم آت نفوسنا تقواها، ‌وزكها ‌أنت خير من زكاها، أنت وليها ومولاها.

اللهم اغفر لنا ما قدمنا وما أخرنا، وما أسررنا وما أعلنا، ‌وما ‌أنت ‌أعلم ‌به ‌منا، أنت ‌المقدم وأنت المؤخر، وأنت على كل شيء قدير.

اللهم اقسم لنا ‌من ‌خشيتك ‌ما ‌تحول به بيننا وبين معاصيك، ومن طاعتك ما تبلغنا به جنتك، ومن اليقين ما تهون به علينا مصيبات الدنيا، ومتعنا اللهم بأسماعنا، وأبصارنا، وقوتنا أبدا ما أحييتنا، واجعله الوارث منا.

اللهم أدم على دولة الإمارات الاستقرار، والرقي والازدهار.

اللهم وفق رئيس الدولة الشيخ محمد بن زايد، ونوابه وإخوانه حكام الإمارات وولي عهده الأمين؛ لما تحبه وترضاه.

اللهم ارحم الشيخ زايد، والشيخ راشد، والقادة المؤسسين، وارحم اللهم الشيخ مكتوم، والشيخ خليفة بن زايد، وأدخلهم بفضلك فسيح جناتك.

واشمل شهداء الوطن برحمتك وغفرانك.

اللهم اغفر لآبائنا وأمهاتنا.

اللهم ارحم المسلمين والمسلمات: الأحياء منهم والأموات.

اللهم اسقنا الغيث ولا تجعلنا من القانطين، اللهم أغثنا، اللهم أغثنا، اللهم أغثنا، اللهم اسقنا من بركات السماء، وأنبت لنا من بركات الأرض، اللهم أغثنا غيثا مغيثا هنيئا واسعا شاملا، تدر به الضرع، وتنبت به الزرع، وتحيي به الأرض.

عباد الله: اذكروا الله العظيم يذكركم، واشكروه على نعمه يزدكم. وأقم الصلاة.

First Khutba

Praise be to Allah, who created the souls and fashioned them. In His Book, He says: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا

He has certainly succeeded who purifies it. (Quran: 91:9).

I bear witness that there is nothing worthy of being worshipped except Allah, alone, without partners, and I bear witness that our master and prophet, Sayyiduna Muhammad, is the servant of Allah and His messenger. O Allah, send Your peace and abundant blessings upon him, his family, his companions, and those who follow him in the best of ways.

To continue: O worshippers of Allah, be conscious of Allah with the true taqwa that He deserves, and watch over yourselves with this Taqwa in private and in public. Know that life consists of fleeting days, for the world is a transient abode, and in the succession of its days and months, there are lessons to be learned. Likewise, in the conclusion of its years, there is space for reflection, and for us, there are examples to learn from those who came before us and lessons to impart for those who come after us. As Allah says: وَاتَّقُوا يَوْمًا ‌تُرْجَعُونَ ‌فِيهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

So fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will compensation be accepted from it, nor will any intercession benefit it, nor will they be aided (Quran: 2:48).

O Believers: Indeed, a person remains in goodness as long as he advises himself and takes himself to account, for base level of the soul incites to evil, and none are safe from that except: إِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّي

Except those upon whom my Lord has had mercy upon. (Quran:12:53).

But it is possible to ascend beyond this base level, and such elevation can only happen through self-accountability as Allah, the Exalted, says: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنْظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow. And fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do (Quran: 59:18).

So the wise one is the person who observes himself and takes himself to account, reflecting on what has passed and preparing for what is to come. The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said:

مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا سَيُكَلِّمُهُ اللَّهُ، لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ تُرْجُمَانٌ، فَيَنْظُرُ أَيْمَنَ مِنْهُ ‌فَلَا ‌يَرَى إلَّا مَا قَدَّمَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ، ‌وَيَنْظُرُ ‌أَيْسَرَ ‌مِنْهُ فَلَا يَرَى إلَّا مَا قَدَّمَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ

There will be none among you but his Lord will talk to him, and there will be no interpreter between him and Allah. He will look to his right and see nothing but his deeds which he has sent forward, and will look to his left and see nothing but his deeds which he has sent forward. [Bukhari]

So, whoever seeks the Hereafter and strives for it, let him maintain continuous self-accountability, and persistently seek what elevates his soul and maintains its happiness. Let his trust in Allah be unwavering, and let his ambition towards excellence not waver, driven by sound will, optimism, hope in Allah, tranquillity, and righteousness. For the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said, ‌الْبِرُّ ‌مَا ‌سَكَنَتْ إِلَيْهِ النَّفْسُ، وَاطْمَأَنَّ إِلَيْهِ الْقَلْبُ، وَالْإِثْمُ مَا لَمْ تَسْكُنْ إِلَيْهِ النَّفْسُ، وَلَمْ يَطْمَئِنَّ إِلَيْهِ الْقَلْبُ

Righteousness is that which the soul is at ease with, and the heart is tranquil with. Sin is that which causes uneasiness in the soul and turmoil in the heart. [Ahmad]

Therefore, the happy one is the one who holds himself accountable and observes his soul to ensure its righteousness. Such a person shall be successful, and have glad tidings for Allah has written his recompense, confirmed it, and shall reward him as He says:

عِنْدَ رَبِّي ‌فِي ‌كِتَابٍ

[Moses] said, The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. (Quran:20:52).

O servants of Allah, the years of our lives pass and continue to unfold, and our actions are recorded in them, and our words and deeds are written.

لَا ‌يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّا أَحْصَاهَا

Every small and great thing is enumerated. (Quran:18:49).

For this reason, it is important for us to strive in performing what Allah has enjoined upon us, in accordance with His saying: وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ

And establish prayer, give zakah, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves—you will find it with Allah. (Quran:2:110).

And let us be good to all people, treating them with kindness, fulfilling their rights, and avoiding any injustice towards them for the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said,

مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ مَظْلَمَةٌ لِأَخِيهِ مِنْ عِرْضِهِ أَوْ شَيْءٍ؛ فَلْيَتَحَلَّلْهُ مِنْهُ

Whoever has done wrong to his brother, whether concerning his honor or anything else, let him seek his pardon. [Bukhari]

O Allah, help us in observing ourselves, fulfilling the rights of others, and grant us all success in obeying You, obeying Your Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and obeying those whom You have placed in authority over us, in accordance with Your saying: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you.

Second Khutba

All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all worlds, and peace and blessings be upon our Master and Prophet, Sayyiduna Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets, and upon his family, companions, and those who follow them in excellence until the Day of Judgment.

O Worshipers: Allah, the Most-High, says:

يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُحْضَرًا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ سُوءٍ تَوَدُّ ‌لَوْ ‌أَنَّ ‌بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُ أَمَدًا بَعِيدًا وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللَّهُ نَفْسَهُ وَاللَّهُ رَءُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ

On the Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allah warns you of Himself, and Allah is Kind to the [His] servants (Quran:3:30)

In other words, Allah is merciful to His creation, desiring that they turn to Him so He may treat them kindly, and warning them about His punishment out of His compassion. He wants them to follow the straight path and uphold His religion, following His noble Messenger (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him). So, let the believer hold himself accountable, reflecting on his relationship with his Lord, fearing Him, obeying Him, hoping in Him, and having Taqwa in his affairs. وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ ‌وَنَهَى ‌النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَى* فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَى

As for the one who fears the position of his Lord and restrains his soul from desires, indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge (Quran:79:40-41).

Let him also hold himself accountable in his relationship with his parents, being kind and respectful to them, following the command of Allah who says:

فَلَا تَقُلْ لَهُمَا أُفٍّ ‌وَلَا ‌تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُلْ لَهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا

And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, 'My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small' (Quran:17:23).

Hence, spouses should hold themselves accountable in their relationship with their children, ensuring proper upbringing. And the student should reflect upon his actions at school to improve his learning. Similarly, the teacher, with his/her students, should assess whether they have sincerely taught and guided them. Those who enjoy the blessings of this land, whether citizens or residents, should ask themselves: What contributions have they made to ensure the stability, progress, and prosperity of this nation? Each person in their respective field should assess themselves to increase their goodness, being mindful of their Creator, who is aware of both their hidden and open deeds. وَمَا ‌يَعْزُبُ ‌عَنْ ‌رَبِّكَ مِنْ مِثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَا أَصْغَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ

And you (Muhammad) art not occupied with any business and thou recitest not a Lecture from this (Scripture), and ye (mankind) perform no act, but We are Witness of you when ye are engaged therein. And not an atom’s weight in the earth or in the sky escapeth your Lord, nor what is less than that or greater than that, but it is (written) in a clear Book. (Quran:10:61).

Let us supplicate: O Allah, grant our souls Taqwa of You and purify them. You are the best to purify them; You are their Protector and Master.

O Allah, forgive us for what we have done in the past and what we may do in the future, what we have concealed, and what is public knowledge. You know everything about us. You are the One who brings forward or delays matters, and You have power over all things.

O Allah, instill in us the Taqwa of You that prevents us from committing sins, the obedience to You that leads us to Your paradise, and the certainty that eases the worldly calamities upon us.

O Allah, bless us with healthy hearing, sight, and strength as long as we live, and let that be an inheritance of righteousness for us.

O Allah, grant stability, prosperity, and progress to the United Arab Emirates. Grant success to the leader, Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed, his deputies, his brothers, the rulers of the Emirates, and his trustworthy Crown Prince, according to Your will and satisfaction .

O Allah, have mercy on the late Sheikh Zayed, Sheikh Rashid, the founding leaders, and in Your mercy, admit them to Your vast gardens.

O Allah, have mercy on Sheikh Maktoum, Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed, and, through Your grace, admit them into Your spacious gardens by Your favor.

O Allah, have mercy on our parents, forgive the Muslims, the living and the deceased.

O Allah, send down your mercy upon us.

O believers, remember Allah the Almighty, and He will remember you. Thank Him for His blessings, and He will increase them. Establish the prayer.
